$comment: Every self-hosted font bundle this site serves, keyed by bundle name.
GENERATED AND MAINTAINED BY tools/self-host-fonts.mjs. `--discover` adds an
entry for any fonts.googleapis.com request still in the tree; `--fetch`
builds public/assets/fonts/<name>.css from the EXACT url below.
The url is the contract. A bundle may only ever replace the request it was
built from: hand a page a real 800 where the CDN synthesised one from 700
and the glyphs widen, the line rewraps, and the page moves.

worksheet-pages.why: Worksheets and answer keys. EXACT MATCH to what generate-worksheets.mjs requested from the CDN — Fraunces 600/700 only, not the 400-900 superset in engine-editorial.css. A superset is not a safe substitute: these pages set headings at weight 800, their original request had no 800 face, so the browser synthesised one from 700. Handing them a real 900 makes matching prefer it, and Fraunces 900 is wider — the line rewraps and the page moves.
